subject: Urgent: MonarchPay production QPS collapse - immediate mitigation and exec coordination
messages:
From: Jared Kim <jared.kim@monarchpay.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: MonarchPay SRE <sre@monarchpay.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production degradation - 5xx spike + extreme latency

Rafael,

We started seeing a sharp spike in 5xxs and median latency at ~09:05 PT. Checkout endpoints are timing out; our observability shows tokens/sec for the Redwood dedicated pool attached to our tenant dropped from ~1.2k to ~180 and overall error-rate jumped to ~12%. Screenshots attached.

This is user-facing and conversion is down. Please confirm if the issue is on Redwood's side and provide an ETA and temporary workarounds (rate-limits, fallback model, or routing).

Attachments: screenshot-500s.png (image/png)

--
Jared Kim
Head of Platform, MonarchPay
jared.kim@monarchpay.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Kim <jared.kim@monarchpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production degradation - 5xx spike + extreme latency

Jared 94 got it, and I'm escalating now. Short initial plan:
1) Ops (Dylan) to pull the last 60m of pool telemetry and confirm whether we are seeing cross-tenant queueing or a per-tenant saturation.
2) Engineering (Vivek) to hypothesize root cause and provide a 30/60/120-minute mitigation matrix.
3) We'll propose a temporary per-tenant QPS cap + hosted fallback routing while we assess need for emergency reserved headroom.

I'll keep you posted every 30 minutes. Rafael
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared Kim <jared.kim@monarchpay.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:38:00-07:00
Subject: Pool telemetry and quick findings

Folks,

Pulled the last 60m and exported key metrics. Quick items:
- Pool-level tokens/sec across nodes in MonarchPay92s dedicated pool dropped sharply at 09:04:58 PT. See pool-usage.csv attached.
- Queue depth increased across GPU hosts rather than a single node, suggesting autoscaler didn't react fast enough.
- KV cache hit-rate fell from 92% to ~48% during the spike (likely cache thrash).
- Error distribution: ~70% 5xxs correspond to OOM/worker restarts; remaining are timeouts.

Immediate recommended mitigations (30m window):
- Enforce per-tenant QPS cap at 600 rps for MonarchPay to stabilize queueing.
- Enable hosted fallback routing for non-critical /batch and async flows.
- Temporarily pin MonarchPay to a lower-memory model variant to reduce KV pressure.

Attaching: pool-usage.csv, qps-heatmap.png

Dylan
Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared Kim <jared.kim@monarchpay.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Root cause hypothesis + mitigation plan (short and medium term)

Summary hypothesis: sudden burst of long-context generation requests from a MonarchPay internal job + a mis-tuned batching window caused KV cache eviction and memory pressure across the dedicated pool. Our runtime experienced worker restarts and higher tail-latency as a knock-on effect.

Short-term (0-2h):
- Apply per-tenant QPS cap (600 rps) and enable hosted fallback routing for low-priority endpoints.
- Roll out a hotfix to reduce batch timeout to avoid runaway batch sizes (15m hotfix window).
- Temporarily shift MonarchPay to a slightly quantized model variant (reduces memory usage).

Medium-term (2-24h):
- Provision emergency reserved headroom (1.5x current allocation) for MonarchPay while we stabilize traffic patterns. Need exec approval for capacity and crediting.
- Investigate autoscaler sensitivity and adjust thresholds to prevent delayed scale events.

If approved, ops can start the emergency allocation in ~45 minutes (dependent on available headroom in the region). I'll prepare a one-page mitigation doc (attached).

Vivek
VP, Serving Runtime Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Kim <jared.kim@monarchpay.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-01T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Customer comms and temporary fallbacks

Jared 94 quick note from CS: we recommend enabling the hosted fallback routing for non-critical checkout enrichment calls immediately (we can do this from the console). That will route a copy to hosted endpoints with lower latency but different cost profile; we'd work with you to confirm parity.

Can you confirm you authorize the fallback switch? Also want to confirm whether MonarchPay wants us to throttle internal batching jobs while we stabilize.

Thanks, Naomi
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared Kim <jared.kim@monarchpay.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Action summary and exec ask - MonarchPay emergency capacity

Team,

Recap / decisions taken so far:
- Per-tenant QPS cap (600 rps) enforced at 10:00 PT.
- Hosted fallback routing enabled for selected non-critical endpoints at 10:15 PT (Jared approved via Slack).
- Hotfix to batch timeout rolled at 10:40 PT; early signals show queueing reduced and KV hit-rate improving.

Remaining ask: we should provision emergency reserved headroom (1.5x) for MonarchPay for the next 24 hours to avoid recurrence while they tune their internal jobs. This requires sales/leadership sign-off for capacity and a short-term credit. Marissa 94 can you confirm approval to allocate emergency capacity and propose the offset (credit vs bill) to Jared? I've attached the mitigation plan for exec review.

Attachments: monarchpay-mitigation-plan.pdf

Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
